text:
katie: quick thread — we need to finalize speaker list + a 20m run of show for the webinar next wed. topic: "Making Inference Predictable: practical levers for cost & latency"
ana: i like that topic. can we tighten the abstract to call out Dedicated vs Hosted use cases?
matt: +1 on use cases. suggestion for abstract: 'real-world patterns for choosing serving modes, tuning batching/quantization, and getting predictable per-token costs'
jules: speaker candidates? i'd propose: matt for product intro (5m), devon for architecture + demo (10m), ana for benchmarks and Q/A lead (5m)
devon: happy to demo. need to know which model + dataset we use for live demo — prefer a small chat model + a reranking example. can we pre-warm KV cache?
katie: yes let's do a short chat demo + rerank. devon, can you confirm environment (hosted vs dedicated) by EOD? also we need a fallback clip in case demo trips.
matt: i can prepare a 1-slide decision flow: when to pick Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. will send draft by tomorrow.
ana: abstract draft: "Teams struggle to balance latency, cost, and reliability. We'll show a pragmatic framework for choosing running modes, concrete tuning steps (batching, cache, quantization), and demo a live rerank that keeps latency under 200ms." thoughts?
jules: looks good. maybe call out "routing & fallback" explicitly — that's a key Redwood differentiator.
katie: ok added. run-of-show 20m (tight):
```
- 0:00-0:01 - intro + housekeeping (katie)
- 0:01-0:06 - product framing & decision flow (matt)
- 0:06-0:16 - live demo: chat + rerank (devon)
- 0:16-0:19 - benchmarks & best-practices (ana)
- 0:19-0:20 - rapid Q&A highlight + CTA (katie)
```
ana: timing looks fine. for benchmarks slide, i'll include a small table showing tokens/sec and median latency across hosted vs dedicated + a note on cost per 1M tokens.
devon: demo fallback plan: record 30s clip of the rerank + a screenshot of console tracing. if live demo fails, we'll cut to clip and briefly narrate what happened + action items.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: rehearsal slot booked: Tue 10:00-10:30 PT in #marketing-rehearsals
katie: perfect. rehearsal checklist (small): mic test, screen share order, demo creds, pre-warm model, fallback clip queued, backup laptop. can everyone ACK and add any missing items?
matt: ack — will also rehearse the one-slide flow, will add a note to avoid real customer data in demo.
ana: ack — will rehearse transitions with devon. i'll bring the benchmark narrative.
devon: ack — will provide demo creds and pre-warm script: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/serve/prewarm -d '{"model":"small-chat","seq":128}'`
jules: ack. i'll handle speaker intros + 1-slide summary at the end for leads routing. question: inbound routing — do we want to route high-traffic trial signups to AE or SDR?
katie: route intent > 2k tokens/month to AE, others to SDR. also add a form field for 'inference use case' so SDRs can triage.
jules: noted. i'll bake that into the post-webinar follow-up doc and lead CSV mapping.
ops-bot: :spiral_note_pad: follow-up doc template created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/marketing/webinar-followup-template
katie: thanks! last ask — can marketing design produce a 1-slide visual for the decision flow by tomorrow noon? @design-team
ana: i'll ping design. tagging them in the rehearsal channel as well. :pray:
katie: great work team — we'll run the full dry run Tue 10 and aim to keep live run within 20m. I'll update the calendar invite with assets to upload before rehearsal.
